messages.subject: Application hangs on shinapps.io (grey screen)
parts:
I have a fairly small app; code is below. It runs like greased lightning on a standard laptop with a very small memory footprint.

When I deploy to shinyapps.io, which goes through without a hitch, it hangs on start up with a grey screen and won't proceed past the original page structure defined in the ui.R. I have it set to "large" in my user options, but it's no where near 1gb (the CSVs referenced are grids of around 20x20 and 20x2 respectively) so it shouldn't be tripping memory requirements:

http://jonathanswalton.shinyapps.io/MarkovChainModeller_App_Demo

Any suggestions please?



ui.R

shinyUI(fluidPage(
 
  titlePanel("Markov Model"),
 
  sidebarLayout(position = "left",
                sidebarPanel(
                     helpText("Select channel to adjust"),
                     selectInput("Channel",
                            label = "Channel to adjust",
                            choices = list("Default"),
                                      selected = "Default"),
                     sliderInput("Adjustment",
                            label = "Select % change:",
                            min = -20, max = 20, value = 0,
                            step = 1)
                ),
                mainPanel(
                    helpText("Modelled Output"),
                    tableOutput("TableState")
                )
  )
))




server.R

#Don't use scientific notation
options(scipen=999)


setwd("X:/MyInternalFolders/Markov_App")
TransitionMatrix.Pct <- read.csv("TransitionMatrix.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", row.names = 1)
TableState <- read.csv("InitialState.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", row.names = 1)


  States  <- length(names(TransitionMatrix.Pct))    # Number of channels (will refer to these subsequently as 'States')
 
  #CHECK That symmetry is present
  if (ncol(TransitionMatrix.Pct) != nrow(TransitionMatrix.Pct)) {stop("Transition Matrix not symmetric - differing numbers of rows and columns")}
  for (x in 1:(States)) {                        
    if (rownames(TransitionMatrix.Pct)[x] != names(TransitionMatrix.Pct)[x]) {stop("Channel column order differs from row order in transition matrix")}
    if (rownames(TransitionMatrix.Pct)[x] != rownames(TableState)[x])        {stop("Transition channels do not match initial state table")}
  }
 
#Initialise dependents

Maxi    <- 20                                   # Number of iterations (shortened for web demo version)

#Run once to build "Starting" position
TableState$CurrentIteration    <- TableState$StartVolume
TableState$OriginalTotal       <- TableState$StartVolume


  for (i in 1:Maxi) {
      for (x in 1:States) {
          TableState$NextIteration[x] <- sum(TableState$CurrentIteration * TransitionMatrix.Pct[x])
      }
    TableState$OriginalTotal <- TableState$OriginalTotal + TableState$NextIteration
    TableState$CurrentIteration <- TableState$NextIteration
  }


# ~~~~~~~~~ SHINY ~~~~~~~~~~~ #


#Set up list for drop down
  ChannelList <- (rownames(TableState))
  ChannelList <- ChannelList[ChannelList != "EXIT"]
  ChannelList <- ChannelList[ChannelList != "ROI_Flag"]

shinyServer(
   
    function(input,output,session) {


            updateSelectInput(session, "Channel",
                              choices = ChannelList)
     
            TableState$NewStartVolume <- TableState$StartVolume
               
            output$TableState <- renderTable({
                                    TableState[input$Channel,]$NewStartVolume <- TableState[input$Channel,]$NewStartVolume * (1+ (input$Adjustment / 100))
                                    TableState$CurrentIteration               <- TableState$NewStartVolume
                                    TableState$NewTotal                       <- TableState$NewStartVolume
           
                                    for (i in 1:Maxi) {
                     
                                      for (x in 1:States) {
                                          TableState$NextIteration[x] <- sum(TableState$CurrentIteration * TransitionMatrix.Pct[x])
                                      }
                                 
                                      TableState$NewTotal <- TableState$NewTotal + TableState$NextIteration
                                      TableState$CurrentIteration <- TableState$NextIteration
                                 
                                    }
 
                                    TableState[(c("StartVolume", "OriginalTotal", "NewStartVolume", "NewTotal"))]
         
                                  }) # End renderTable
     
      } # End function

) # End shiny server

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Application hangs on shinapps.io (grey screen)
parts:
Hi Jon,
The easiest thing to do is to look at the output of the logs.  You can do that by running shinyapps::showLogs() or by looking at the logs tab in the Application tab within the shinyapps.io dashboard.
In this case, I can see the error.  You have a setwd() call that is an absolute path, you can't do that with shinyapps.io.  You need to have the directory that has the content you are loading within the directory structure of the application itself and you can then refer to it with relative paths.

Hope this helps.
-Tareef

                                      TableState$NewTotal <- TableState$NewTotal + TableState$NextIteration
                                      TableState$CurrentIteration <- TableState$NextIteration
                                 
                                    }
